rationale: The workflow runs a 24-crate Rust matrix that fetches the Rust toolchain and crate dependencies on every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (evidence: experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200) measured a 20.4% elapsed-time reduction by adding a dependency cache keyed to lockfiles, with no change to build/test coverage. Prerequisites are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs in every matrix job, and the cache key can include Cargo.lock files plus runner OS. No contraindications apply: there is no existing cache, and the cargo registry/git stores immutable, content-addressed downloads rather than mutable build outputs. The change adds a single cache step after Rust installation and before any cargo invocation, preserving all existing steps, environment variables, matrix coverage, and required checks.
